channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Cameron Payne | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Cameron Payne from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kyle Draper on Cameron Payne
item.description:
Sactown Sports 1140's Kyle Draper stated today on The Drive Guys that there's a veteran point guard who has his eye on coming to Sacramento to help fill the possible gap in the roster.

“I know of another guard that would love to come and play in Sacramento. His representative are trying to angle him to Sac. Cam Payne,”

Kyle Draper on Cameron Payne, Jul 11, 2025. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Zach LaVine on Cameron Payne
item.description:
Zach LaVine on Cam Payne:

“Cam looks good, really comfortable. His shot looks really good. He knows all the plays. I think he’s going to fit in really easy. He’s confident.”

Zach LaVine on Cameron Payne, Feb 22, 2018. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Charlie Villanueva on Kevin Durant, Russell Westbrook, Cameron Payne
item.description:
Charlie Villanueva:

“I guess I went viral. Everybody was talking about me interrupting their – Russell Westbrook and Cameron Payne’s routine or dance, whatever you want to call it. And I heard their response. I heard Russell Westbrook talking about those are for the guys that don’t play, and I don’t necessarily know who he’s talking about because Cameron Payne and myself, we both had the same stat line. And Kevin Durant added his two cents, but, you know, Kevin’s a good kid, so I’m just gonna leave him alone.”

Charlie Villanueva on Kevin Durant, Russell Westbrook, Cameron Payne, Apr 19, 2016. Source: The Big Lead.
